subject: Intro: Stratus Analytics — request for demo and technical topics
messages:
From: Elliot Dawson <elliot.dawson@stratus-analytics.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Benchmark download + request for quick demo

Hi Jordan,

I downloaded the benchmark report yesterday (great read — clear comparisons!) and self-signed for a trial. We're evaluating options to replace an aging inference layer and I wanted to see Redwood in action. Could we set up a 30-minute demo focused on:
- typical latency/cost tradeoffs for short-chat workloads
- quantization/accuracy impacts for our 1.5B models
- deployment options (VPC/private) and audit logging

Attaching the CSV export we used for our internal scoring. Our CTO, Priya Malhotra, will probably sit in — happy to include procurement if there's a cost/terms discussion.

Available windows next week M-W, mornings PT.

Thanks,
Elliot Dawson
Head of Platform Engineering
Stratus Analytics
Attachment: Stratus-benchmark-report.csv (text/csv)
From: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
To: Elliot Dawson <elliot.dawson@stratus-analytics.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Benchmark download + request for quick demo

Hi Elliot — thanks for the note and for downloading the benchmark. Glad you found it useful.

I can definitely set up a focused 30-minute session. Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Mar 21, 09:00–09:30
- Tue Mar 21, 11:00–11:30
- Wed Mar 22, 08:30–09:00

If none of those work, send a few times that do and I’ll accommodate. For the demo, I’ll bring Ava (Solutions Engineer) to dig into quantization and the VPC/private deployment flow. Monica from CS is cc'd so we can make sure trial access and onboarding items are ready.

Quick ask before the meeting: could you confirm whether SSO (SAML) and on-prem routing are required in the POC? That will help us tailor the run-through.

Calendars: https://cal.com/jordan-redwood/30min?cid=RW-2028-0847

Best,
Jordan Blake
SDR, Redwood Inference
Attachment: proposed-demo-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Elliot Dawson <elliot.dawson@stratus-analytics.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Malhotra <priya.malhotra@stratus-analytics.com>, procurement@stratus-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 15 Mar 2028 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Benchmark download + request for quick demo

Jordan — thanks, those times look good. Tue Mar 21 11:00 PT works best for us. Priya will join the meeting. Procurement included for visibility (they may have a few standard questions).

To answer your question: yes, SSO via SAML is a requirement for production; for the POC it's optional but we would like to discuss audit log retention and whether logs can be forwarded to our SIEM. Also curious about private deployments — we operate in a locked-down VPC so want to understand network requirements.

See you on Tue.

Elliot

Ava / Monica — looping you both in. Elliot (Stratus) confirmed Tue 21 Mar at 11:00 PT for a 30-min session. Primary goals per Elliot:
- latency/cost tradeoffs for short-chat (1.5B)
- quantization impact on accuracy
- SSO (SAML) + audit log forwarding + VPC networking constraints

Ava: can you lead the demo and prepare a 10-min tech deep-dive on quantization and the private deployment checklist? If you can include an example of audit log export (syslog/HTTPS) that would be helpful.

Monica: please prepare trial enablement steps and a short checklist for the POC (roles, sample data access, retention settings). Procurement is on copy on Elliot's reply; we should be ready to answer basic billing/terms questions that may come up after the demo.

I’ll create the invite and attach the agenda. Let me know if you want to shift to a double-length slot (45) — Elliot asked for a lean run-through, so I stuck with 30.

Thanks — Jordan

- Ava: include the audit export example and SAML overview (5–7 min)
- Jordan: forward the CSV and agenda to Priya and procurement (done)
